items.title: 刚刚，DeepSeek重磅开源：Agent底座架构！

extra.evidence: AI已经自己找到Bug并提交PR 要知道，此前不少人还在等DeepSeek推出传闻中的「dsh dot」，结果这次先等来了一篇面向工程实践的架构思路探讨—— 何意味？AI可以在没人@、没人下指令的情况下，自己发现Bug、定位问题，甚至主动提交修复PR了。 甚至它还能持续关注工作群消息，跨平台协作、并行处理多个复杂任务，甚至实现24小时在线运行。 在模拟多任务环境中，Super-agent的任务完成时间中位数为12.4分钟，95分位数为15.7分钟，表现优于测试中的传统单会话方案。 AI，真的开始有能力从等待人类逐项分配任务，进一步走向主动发现问题、持续推进工作了。 在日常软件开发过程中，开发人员经常碰到的一个问题是，我们需要在不同平台之间来回切换！！ 比如，先在IM群聊里讨论技术方案，随后到GitHub提交代码，再根据PR评论修改实现。 DeepSeek团队在文章中提到，根据他们的观察，一个人通常只能同时跟进3到5个活跃Session。 这就带来了一个问题：随着模型处理单项任务的能力越来越强，多任务协作的效率，却越来越容易受到人类注意力的限制。 在DeepSeek团队内部运行的实例中，同一个开发任务可以从IM群聊一直延续到GitHub PR评审。 Super-agent能够理解这两条消息属于同一项工作，并据此调整后续执行方向。 用户面对的始终是同一个Agent，底层的多个会话则由系统自行管理，而且它开始主动参与工作。 这里还用到了一项技术—— 投机执行（Speculative Execution） 。 比如群里有人讨论一个Bug，Super-agent便先着手复现、查找原因，如果最终找到简单可行的修复方案，就把结果交给用户。 收到会议邀约后，AI可以提前检查日程冲突、整理相关资料，并准备好回复草稿，等待用户确认。 上层叫Router，可以理解为负责接收消息和统筹任务的调度…

items.title: Show HN: A working Nintendo in ~1GB of Qwen weights

extra.evidence: An NES CPU compiled into the weights of a stock Qwen3.5 model - dbreunig/nesformer The NES's 6502 CPU (the core of its 2A03 chip), its 2 KB of work RAM, and a cartridge's program ROM run inside a standard Qwen3_5ForCausalLM checkpoint. Nobody trained these weights; a compiler computed every one. When you play a game, the model predicts the CPU's execution log one token at a time. A small host program plays the rest of the console around it: it draws the picture, reads the controller, and fires the vblank interrupt. nesformer builds on Qwenputer by Divyansh Agrawal , which compiled a CHIP-8 and then a RISC-V CPU into Qwen3.5-4B. It reuses Qwenputer's compiler and its central trick: the model's Gated DeltaNet state is the machine's memory. Every CPU token in these runs came from the model.…

items.title: 世界模型首次指导设计芯片！超大核NPU700TOPS，99%算力可用

extra.evidence: AI算力利用“九九成” 以智驾模型知名的 Momenta ，出现在了一家成立仅仅两年多的芯片公司首次公开亮相里。 芯片名字叫 X7 Ultra ，只看算力数值，在2026年底已经不能算“极致”了—— 700 TOPS 。 它想表达的是：X7 Ultra的确有更高的推理效率，但没有放任量化误差无限扩大，而是要求量化后的模型输出尽可能贴近FP32模型。 因为大模型实在太能吃算力、内存和功耗了，把模型权重和计算精度压下来的主要途径，就是减少存储与计算开销。但压得太狠，输出也可能出现偏差。 第二个指标，是 NPU计算利用率达到98.7% ，意味着芯片里的AI计算单元，在运行测试任务时，绝大部分时间都在执行有效的计算工作，闲置时间很少。 这通常也意味着芯片架构、数据传输和软件调度之间配合得比较好，计算单元不容易因为等数据、等指令而空转。 官方给出的参考数据是：对比行业旗舰产品，内存带宽消耗降低80%，能效提升100%。 过去谈TOPS，多用稠密算力或稀疏算力，这些概念可以说明芯片的理论计算能力，却很难单独回答一个更贴近实际体验的问题：把真正用于智能驾驶的模型放上去，究竟能跑多快、跑得有多稳？ 例如，实验室里的APS等测试指标单独测量某个模型的运行耗时，都能帮助工程师分析芯片性能。 但真实智驾大模型涉及复杂的网络结构、不同类型的算子、频繁的数据读写，以及多种计算任务之间的调度；只追求某个环节跑得很快意义有限，因为其他环节却因为等待数据、内存带宽不足或调度效率不高而拖慢整体速度。 “大模型算力”的评测思路，是直接使用真实量产智驾模型测试芯片 ，而不是只依赖实验室基准测试。 这套评测还有另外几项明确约束：模型结构不能随意改变，计算精度必须得到保证，最终驾驶体验也不能打折，芯片需要在这些条件都成立的情况下，尽可能提高模型运行效率。 这就是“大模型算力”想要衡量的东西：在真实量产模型和严格部…

items.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
items.summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare LLaDA-V's predictions with and without the image at every decoding step and find that removing the image changes a token being unmasked at only 22.8% of steps on average and at as few as 7.9%. We therefore propose LOWN, a decoding method that decides at every step whether to process the image and how many tokens to unmask. LOWN predicts the masked tokens without the image and processes the image only when this prediction disagrees with the last image-conditioned prediction. Agreement certifies the earlier prediction for reuse, and the number of certified tokens sets how many are unmasked in that step. We further observe that the need for the image differs across benchmarks, so LOWN's adaptive decision is needed rather than a fixed schedule. Without training or a tuned threshold, LOWN retains 99.6% of LLaDA-V's score on ten benchmarks at 35.3% of the decoding FLOPs on average. LOWN also generalizes across LLaDA-based DVLMs, composes orthogonally with visual token pruning, and runs und…
items.title_zh: Look Only When Needed：基于证书引导的视觉路由
items.summary_zh: 扩散视觉语言模型在每一步都处理全部输入，计算开销大。本文提出LOWN方法，通过比较有无图像的预测结果来决定是否处理图像。实验表明，该方法在保持99.6%性能的同时，将解码计算量降低至35.3%。

items.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
items.summary: Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful prior knowledge. It is essential for agents learning over long time horizons, yet current evaluations largely assess individual task performance rather than improvement through accumulated experience. We introduce Continual Learning Exam (CLE), a large-scale benchmark developed by 50+ domain experts to measure experience-driven improvement in realistic professional workflows. CLE comprises 120 human-authored tasks, each organised as a five-level ladder, yielding 600 levels spanning 89 professional roles across 12 occupational domains. Agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with later levels building on experience accumulated during earlier assignments. An evaluation agent assesses each submission against human-authored rubrics. We compare a single-submission setting with one that provides diagnostic feedback after failure and allows one revision. Across 17 harness-model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs. As such, the dataset can also be used to post-train LLMs to strengthen their continual learning capabilities.

items.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
items.summary: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-ar…

items.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
items.summary: Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks. Starting from professional intents, information-level planning builds an information support graph to guide task instantiation, explicitly representing the dependencies and locations of information required for the intended outputs. Probe executions then identify support failures and guide repairs while preserving the intended work. We construct 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use the collected teacher trajectories to fine-tune Qwen models at 4B, 27B, and 35B-A3B scales, yielding the WorkPilot family. All three models improve over their respective base models across four professional-work benchmarks, with WorkPilot-35B-A3B improving from 879 to 1565 Elo on GDPval-AA v2.1. Scaling analyses reveal model-dependent diminishing returns, with execution length first increasing and then decreasing. Controlled component analyses show that planning and repair reduce probe-diagnosed task environment defects and improve downstream performance. The data and models are available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/WorkFactory.
items.title_zh: WorkFactory：将专业意图转化为可执行工作
items.summary_zh: 专业任务信息缺失会阻碍教师执行。本文提出WorkFactory框架，通过信息级规划和探针执行构建112,686个任务。实验显示，该方法能生成高质量的教师轨迹，并显著提升Qwen模型在专业工作基准上的表现。

items.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
items.summary: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. items.title_zh: Rollback：世界模型中的经验回溯与策略改进
items.summary_zh: 现有世界模型仅作为前向模拟器，缺乏回溯能力。本文提出Rollback范式，通过回溯到关键决策点并探索反事实未来，生成细粒度的动作级监督。实验表明该方法在三个真实机器人任务中提升了成功率。
